en: Sepia-toned street-and-canal view labeled at the bottom. On the right are tall brick residential buildings with rounded corners and many windows; one ground-floor business has a sign reading "RIJN-BAR". People in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the sidewalk and a cart stands in the street. On the left side runs a quayside along a broad canal with moored boats and distant bridges. The captions "Amsterdam" and "Amstelkade" identify the location.
